headline: The Art of Escape
primaryText: See the world from a different perspective. Explore iconic destinations aboard a luxury yacht, with personalised itineraries, world-class service and the freedom to experience every moment your way.
whyItWorks: Bright, aspirational photos of a couple on a yacht and an empty turquoise beach sell the feeling of the trip before any detail. Short overlay lines on each card make the swipe-through easy to scan, and the primary text stresses personalisation and freedom for a high-end buyer. The soft Learn More call to action fits a considered, high-ticket purchase, and the ad has run for over two months.
